currentEvidence.locator: Current May 19 2026-produced school guide, printed back-cover page 8: paired SB-dori school stops and current public name, with Kokusai Kogyo Kamiitabashi/Oji service explicitly identified.

historicalEvidence.locator: Historical school access PDF single page: paired SB-dori stops immediately by north school approach, Kokusai Kogyo identified below.

currentStopNameReview.physicalContinuityReview: Individually viewed historical primary school diagram and current school diagram/May 2026-produced school guide show the same paired bus stops on SB-dori at the north school approach, with the same road junctions and school site. Both attribute the service to Kokusai Kogyo. Separately licensed P11 exact operator and historical Ou54/54-2 context anchor the historical component. The current school guide explicitly confirms Kamiitabashi/Oji service. This is an independently reviewed road-stop representative correspondence, not fuzzy-name matching, exact-pole equivalence or an inferred effective rename date.

rightsReview.reason: Association public copyright notice and full disclaimer reviewed; no separate restriction on minimum independently recorded traffic facts found. Association reports direct investigation with bus operators. Retain only minimum ordered calls from its two distinct directional Ou54 route-specific stop tables, URL/date/hash and licensed P11 identities; no timetable clocks, fares, map geometry, artwork or full database extraction. Ou54-2 has a distinct terminus and is excluded. Association legacy school-stop label is historical and is explicitly reconciled with independently reviewed current public-school access evidence. Current municipal station/route publications corroborate active service. Contractor-owned restrictive pages remain discovery only, not production sources.
